meta_description: Answers with citations, not vibes — permission-aware retrieval over your regulated document estate.

blocks.x: Answers with citations, not vibes — permission-aware retrieval over your regulated document estate.

The workhorse of enterprise GenAI is retrieval-augmented generation done properly: hybrid lexical-plus-semantic search, structure-aware chunking for contracts, filings, SOPs and clinical protocols, permission propagation from the source system, and reranking that respects both relevance and freshness. We build retrieval platforms where every answer carries citations back to the source document and paragraph.

The hard parts are organizational as much as technical: document estates are duplicated, stale and inconsistently access-controlled. Our delivery includes a knowledge inventory and remediation plan, connector framework for SharePoint, Confluence, DMS and file shares, and freshness SLAs so the corpus does not rot — the failure mode that kills user trust in month three.
